Segnala offerta di lavoro Chaberton Professionals, divisione di Chaberton Partners dedicata alla ricerca e selezione di profili di Middle e Top Management, è attualmente alla ricerca di una figura di un Brand Manager part- time per realtà Cliente, filiale italiana di un gruppo internazionale nel Food & Beverage . Principali responsabilità: Contribuire alla crescita e al posizionamento del brand sul mercato italiano, in linea con le strategie e le linee guida dell’Headquarters. Definire e implementare il piano marketing, in collaborazione con il Marketing Director e con i team internazionali. Presidiare le attività di category e trade marketing, supportando il raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali. Analizzare i dati di mercato e le performance di sell-in e sell-out, individuando opportunità di crescita e aree di miglioramento. Monitorare i KPI, il budget marketing e il ritorno delle iniziative implementate. Elaborare analisi e reportistica attraverso Excel e Power BI, a supporto delle decisioni strategiche. Collaborare con la funzione Vendite e con l’Headquarters per garantire coerenza tra le strategie globali e le esigenze del mercato italiano. Requisiti: Almeno 8 anni di esperienza consolidata in ruoli di Brand Management a forte taglio commerciale, category o trade marketing in aziende FMCG, preferibilmente nel settore Food & Beverage. Spiccata attitudine quantitativa e ottima padronanza di Excel e Power BI. Inglese fluente, per la collaborazione quotidiana con l’Headquarters internazionale. Approccio strategico, attitudine imprenditoriale e orientamento ai risultati. Orario di lavoro: part-time al 60%. Retribuzione: RAL € 45.000 – € 55.000 + MBO. Sede di lavoro: Milano. About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Combining deep Amazon expertise with strong business acumen, you will connect Retail, Media and Data to identify growth opportunities, define cross-channel recommendations and guide investment decisions. You will act as a senior advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, coordinating specialist teams and ensuring consistent delivery across eCommerce, media, measurement and analytics workstreams. Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, manage expectations and establish credibility with senior internal and external stakeholders. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 50.000,00 €/yr - 70.000,00 €/anno About Pillar Pillar is an Italian startup founded on February 13, 2025. In less than a year, we raised €15.2 million to revolutionize the construction industry, and we are growing fast. Our mission is to rebuild its foundations. Our ambition is to manage 1 in 3 construction sites in Europe. We are Italian, but with a European vision 🚀 The Italian construction industry is the backbone of the country's economy, involving nearly 5 million people, yet it is still managed with outdated tools. Pillar was built to solve this problem at its root. We have built an all-in-one platform that allows construction companies to oversee every job site and monitor profitability in real time. Why Join Us Now We are a sales-driven B2B SaaS business today, and HubSpot sits at the centre of almost everything: how leads come in, how they're worked, how customers are retained, how the business is measured. As we scale, more products, more teams touching the same system, the cost of an under-owned CRM compounds fast: broken attribution, inconsistent data, automations built by five different people with five different logics, sales and marketing arguing about whose numbers are right. This is a hands-on, technical, and strategic role and a founding one . You'll be the first hire on CRM, which means you'll be the one building workflows, custom properties, integrations, and reporting yourself from day one. As scope grows, you'll also be responsible for building the team around you, but the first chapter of this role is entirely hands-on. What You'll Do In practice: Platform ownership & architecture Own HubSpot's full architecture: object model, properties, pipelines, permissions, and data hygiene standards. Define and enforce data governance: naming conventions, required fields, deduplication logic, lifecycle stage definitions. Build and maintain integrations between HubSpot and the rest of the stack (ad platforms, product/data warehouse, billing, support tools), including API-level work when needed. Own technical debt: audit what's been built ad hoc so far, and re-architect what doesn't scale. Acquisition Own tracking and attribution infrastructure inside HubSpot: UTM governance, form tracking, CAPI/server-side integrations, offline conversion imports. Partner with Paid and SEO/Content to make sure every channel's performance is measurable and trustworthy inside the CRM. Build lead scoring and routing logic that actually reflects how the business qualifies and converts. Lifecycle & automation Design and build lifecycle marketing automation: nurture flows, lifecycle stage transitions, behavioral triggers, holdout/measurement frameworks as we scale. Own segmentation infrastructure so campaigns can be built on reliable, real-time data. Build the reporting layer that shows what's actually driving pipeline and retention, not vanity dashboards. Sales enablement & RevOps Own the CRM architecture that underpins sales operations: pipeline structure, deal automation, sequences, playbooks embedded in the tool itself. Partner closely with Sales leadership and the RevOps team to make sure CRM structure and their operational needs stay aligned as the business scales. Build the infrastructure needed for a multi-product sales motion, routing, product-specific pipelines, cross-sell/upsell logic, as the product line expands, in a way that RevOps can execute against. Scaling for growth Design HubSpot's architecture to support multiple products and multiple countries without collapsing into chaos, multi-currency, multi-language, market-specific pipelines and reporting. Own the roadmap for when and how we evolve beyond native HubSpot capabilities (reverse-ETL, CDP, data warehouse) as complexity grows. Who We're Looking For This is you if: You have deep, hands-on HubSpot expertise. You're comfortable with the technical side: APIs, webhooks, custom-coded workflows, data modeling. You've owned CRM/marketing automation in a B2B SaaS environment. You think in systems: you can look at a messy, organically grown CRM and see the architecture it should have. You understand both sides of the house: how marketing generates and nurtures demand, and how sales works and closes it. You're comfortable owning data quality and governance, not just campaigns. You've dealt with scaling complexity before: multiple products, multiple markets. You're comfortable being a founding, individual-contributor hire first. You know how to set standards and guidelines for teams that execute independently. NICE TO HAVE: Experience in a company that scaled from single-product/single-market to multi-product/multi-market. Background in a startup or high-growth environment. What We Offer Competitive compensation : €50,000-€70,000, tailored to experience and expertise. Growth: Meritocratic growth: impact = advancement. Location: Milan Office: A role based in Milan, under Pillar’s applicable working model. Team: Offsite every 6 months · young and ambitious environment.
